title: ♠️ Create & Watch: Playing Card Collaging
description:
Create a deck that's uniquely yours while enjoying a film inspired by creativity, mystery, and imagination.
Join the IRL Club for a creative movie afternoon where we'll transform ordinary playing cards into tiny works of art. Using collage materials, paper, stickers, stamps, and other creative supplies, you'll design your own custom cards while enjoying a cozy film screening.
Whether you want to create a themed deck, experiment with collage, or simply relax and make something with your hands, this is a low-pressure creative workshop for all skill levels.
Your ticket includes:
🃏 A deck of playing cards to customize
✂️ Collage supplies and creative materials
🍿 Snacks and refreshments
🎬 A cozy film screening
✨ Time to create, chat, and connect
No artistic experience needed—just bring your imagination and enjoy an afternoon of making something unique.
Come solo or bring a friend. Leave with a deck that's completely your own!
